| `mass_rate` | `float \| None` | `None` | Required whenever injection_mode is present. For MANUAL/ MANUAL_FRACKING_CHECK/AUTO_PRESSURE this is the fixed mass rate used every timestep. | `max_mass_rate` | `float \| None` | `None` | Optional cap (kg/s) on the mass rate AUTO_FLOW/AUTO_BOTH's Picard iteration converges to — `mass_rate = min(fracking_flow(...), max_mass_rate)` each pass. None (default) means uncapped: mass_rate converges to whatever fracking_flow() actually computes. Must be omitted for every other injection_mode — there is nothing for it to cap. |
